balls.text: inswinging yorker and Milne gets some bat on it, not a lot. Enough for them to get two by the time long on runs across to his right
the fast bowler has no idea about the lack of pace here. He comes down and drives, but the bal sneaks under his bat to fix him completely

struck right in front and that's as plumb as it gets, Ngidi gets his second! Jurel moved a long way towards off and that full delivery has struck him right in front. Jurel has reviewed even though there's no bat, so it's curtains for him
134.1kmh, pace on for a change and that's tailing in towards the stumps, he drives it along the ground for two

he dances down and Ngidi delivers it out of his reach, beyond the tram line and it's called a wide. But DC review it. Jurel had taken a step towards off and the ball was inside the revised guide line. So it's a dot
can't put away the full toss around knee height, single to long on
a single straight down to long off for Archer and Starc ends with an excellent over
and he strikes again! Starc gets his fourth as Shanaka holes out. He wants to clear that cover boundary again, but can't quite middle this one and Stubbs does well to settle under it
another attempted yorker, Jurel scythes it away square for one
Shanaka is trying to predict, he thinks it'll be a yorker and he's right. So he makes room and carves it over the covers in the gap before Stubbs at long off cuts it off
goes for the yorker angling in, Shanaka lofts it straight down to long on for two
scythes it to point for a very risky single but they make it, and that's Jurel's fifty off 36 balls
low and dipping slower full toss at 112kmh, Shanaka swings wildly and misses
expects the yorker this time so shuffles to off for a scoop but he only manages some but. Can't run across too
Shanaka breathes some life into this innings! Charges down the pitch, takes on the slower one from way outside off and hammers that over the long on boundary by a mile
136kmh, some pace and a low full toss too, pushed down with a single to long on
slower one as expected, really slow and even though it's slightly wide, Jurel can't connect
nails the yorker first ball and Shanaka manages a single, but with a leg bye to leg
126kmh, length ball outside off and he pushes it to deep point for one. Excellent finish for Madhav Tiwari

holed out on the leg side, another one perishes for RR! Only a bit more pace around 127kmh from Tiwari, Dubey pulls it away but can't get enough power behind it and T Vijay swallows it at deep square leg. Tiwari is pumped
he tries it again, slower and shorter ball wide outside off. And not given a wide this time. It's now RR's turn to chat for a review but they decide not to

slower ball at just 110.1kmh, that's given a wide outside off, it was pretty short too. And DC review it after a chat. Dubey moved a tiny bit to off when the ball was delivered and the ball is inside the wide line, so dot ball
tight for Jurel too, he works it to leg with the angle for one
starts with a length ball around off, a single down to long off
some room from Axar to end his night with the ball, steered wide of crease for one
makes some room by backing away, cuts for a single
worked off the pads again to leg for one more
a tad too short and he smashes it into the ground on leg for one
more on leg this time and he nudges it square for one
stifling line on the stumps, defends it to leg
swing for Starc into the pads, Shubham flicks it with that behind square on leg for one

third wicket in four balls! Although Ravi has reviewed it for lbw. Top work from Starc to deceive the batter. He takes the pace off and sends down a cutter, Ravi is too early into his shot and the ball hits him right in front of middle and off, with the off stump clearly visible. No edge, going straight for the stumps and that's a review gone for RR
Ravi survives as Starc goes for the yorker but misses it a little. Ravi gets a low full toss on middle and leg, and he does well to flick it away and beat the diving fielder in the deep for four

a sitter for Axar this time and that's two in two for Starc! He gets the big wicket of Ferreira. Pace on this time for the short ball, the batter is slightly cramped for room as he goes for the pull down the ground but can't quite swing freely and hands a catch to long on

Starc strikes and that's a sharp catch from Axar at long-on! Starc pitched it up outside off but rolled his fingers over that one to make it an offcutter, and Parag mistimes straight down, where Axar does very well to dive forward and get both his hands under the ball cleanly
short ball on leg, he pulls with hard hands for one
excellent reply from Axar after the first ball four. Ends the over with a dot as Prag fails to connect with the pull and takes it on the pads
85.6kmh, just outside off and Jurel taps it square on off for one
room outside off but Parag chooses to go downtown. Reaches long on after a bounce
tight line to Jurel too, clipped down to long on for one
another fifty for Parag, this one off 23 balls. He waits on the back foot and nudges it to leg for one
luck is favouring Parag too! He manages only a thick inside edge while trying to slam it away from outside off, and that goes just past Rahul for four more
beats Starc at long on! Into the pitch and the length is short enough for Jurel to hang back and slap it right back, not far from Parag, but far enough from the diving Starc to get four
goes haywire with his slower one, wide outside off
change of pace, this one at 116.1kmh, and Parag doesn't pick it too well. Pushed awkwardly down to long off for one
makes the line tighter again, this one is towards the body and he clips it to leg for one
bit more room and Jurel pounces on that by rocking on the back foot and slices it away for a cracking four
pretty tight outside off and Jurel taps it to point
short outside off with pace off, Parag slaps it down to long off
nearly nails the yorker to end the over, sigh of relief or Mukesh and DC. A single to deep midwicket
third six of the over! Mukesh goes short now, bangs it into the pitch and Parag is reading these lengths so well, slaps it right back into the sight screen
disappears over long-on! That's gone over to the Feroz Shah Kotla fort. Parag picks the slower ball around length and swings another one down, and knows instantly that's gone all the way
134.1kmh, from too short to too full and that's smoked over the covers for four! He had to clear just the one fielder in the covers and his booming drive did that
much closer to this body and another Parag six on the leg side! Short of length, angling in towards the body and Parag's pull takes care of it
back of length outside off, some room too but Parag can't quite middle it
a bit loopy towards middle with some drift, driven back to Axar
shorter and quicker to Jurel, he cuts it to point
slow on off again, it works again, as Parag swings but only manages an inside edge to leg
pitched up and that's gone all the way again! On middle stump, Parag doesn't have to do anything but swing with the line and he does that right off the middle
slows it down a fair bit on off, pulls the length shorter too and Parag carefully pushes to leg
dispatched over deep midwicket! That's pitched up, and almost like Parag was waiting for it, he smashes it just over the leaping fielder at the rope
Back of length outside off, whipped across to deep midwicket's left
Wide back of length ball is let go, bounces on the way to the keeper
This time he lets the short ball go. Slow again, above head-height

Tennis-forehand... is taken! Being checked for fair catch actually... And Parag has lucked out, because Stubbs smushed the ball into the ground as he took the low catch to his left. He was running across from long-on and the fingers were pointing down as he caught it, so the fingers weren't under the ball. Was a short slower ball just outside off, touch over head-height, Parag didn't have room and swung across from high to low with a full follow-through
Tiwari goes beyond the perpendicular for the slower ball into the pitch. Touch too straight. Pulled to deep-backward square, who does well to stop it
Nice drive back, Tiwari does well in his follow-through to his right. Pitched up on middle and leg, Jurel was a touch too far inside the line but managed it nicely
Pitched up outside off, may have been slow. Nope, 128ks. Driven through extra cover
Back of length just outside off, cut to backward point
Length just outside off, driven off the back foot. Miller, who's well inside the ring, stops it. Seems to have plonked his knee onto the pitch there
Length on leg, flicked to deep-backward square

Axar convinced that's lbw, not given. Impact point might be the issue. DC review. Wide release from Axar as is often the case, landed on a length just outside off. It beat the reverse sweep, went under bat, and hit the outer-edge of the front pad just under the knee-roll. Height not an issue... but the impact is! It's outside off and Axar smiles on his way back
Inside out over extra cover. Not much room, the batter was beside the line and hit with the ball in line with his front pad
Fullish on leg, 92ks, defended straight
Length just outside off, driven to mid-off
Off the hand, that looked like a legcutter. Shortish just outside off, 111ks, cut to deep cover and the DJ plays Boney M's Rasputin right after
Back of length around off, 112ks, short-arm pull to deep midwicket
Shortish ball just outside off, punched to long-off

Shot checked.... and ball doesn't travel! Tiwari gets Sooryavanshi with a 129ks slot ball. Off-stump line, batter was on middle and off and went back in the crease for the straight drive. Played it too early, might have been better served going through with the shot. Miller slides to the right and takes it at long-off. He covered 24 metres, graphic shows. Pumps his fists, bowler's delighted too
Length around off, punched to long-off
Dug deep into the pitch again, slow again. Sooryavanshi jumps and isn't balanced as he pulls it from outside off to deep midwicket
Slower bouncer called wide for height. Very short, landed on leg and angled away. Ducked under
No big shot this time, just a punched single to long-off. Length ball just outside off, hit off the back foot
Length on leg, flicked through square leg. Wanted two, but no
Big six over cow corner. Jurel dancing down and across, slogging it off a length. Slog might not be fair as it was a very clean hit with a vertical bat
Long-off almost overran it, Starc just about manages to stretch to his right and catch it on the bounce. Sooryavanshi swung hard again but mistimed it
Bad ball, just one to deep-backward square. This was wrung short and down leg, Jurel got square-on and muscled a flat pull, placement not great
Touch short outside off at 83ks, cut to long-off's right
Looked to scythe it through point, gets it back to the bowler. Yorker just outside off, not as wide as Jurel wanted it. He was looking at point and took a couple of steps before stopping. Timeout
Bumper. Jurel gets across and lets it go to his left
Driven on the rise. Well over and straight of mid-on. Axar not happy. Wasn't that bad a ball though. Maybe a touch too full if at all. Jurel gripped the bat low and drove it across
Outswinger goes straight and is his straight over the boundary. Goes a few rows back. Slot ball around off, Jurel stands still again and slugs it across the line
Cuffed past the bowler. Great shot to a hard-length ball. Just outside off, Jurel had a strong base and flat-batted it to the bowler's left
Yorker just outside off, driven hard with good timing. Miller stops it at cover by getting low
Back of length outside off, 135ks, cut hard to deep-backward point
Not short but pummeled! It sat up and was at the pad, Sooryavanshi cleared the front leg and pulled it a mile over midwicket. Miller has a word with the bowler later

Vijay should have Sooryavanshi here, Vijay should have had Sooryavanshi here! Rizvi ran back from mid-on, was halfway into the outfield and had to change directions late as he dove for the catch. Doesn't get it and it rolls to the boundary. Was a length ball angling in towards off, Sooryavanshi had room but didn't get to the pitch. He slashed across his body and toed it high into the sky
Gives it air, hits a good length on off. Defended to cover. 92ks
Room. Slapped! Length ball around sixth stump, invites a small stride forward and flat-bat hit over mid-off
Punches it to the fielder at cover this time

Thought he knocked it to the fielder, but no, Sooryavanshi has casually driven it to the cover bounday. Not too short but close to the top of off, Sooryavanshi took his front leg leg side and drove it off the back foot

Tough chance for Rahul, he gloves it into the ground! It was closer to where first slip would've stood but Rahul covered the distance with his dive. Ball hit high on his gloves and popped off before he could claw it in. Was a back of length ball at pace outside off, Jurel got a thick edge on the back-foot cover drive
Ngidi's bowled 11 balls so far, wouldn't be surprised if 7-8 are slower ones. Including this one. It's a dipping low full toss outside off, Jurel waits and collapses a touch as he works it leg side
Pitched up outside off, driven to cover point. SLiding stop

Pitched up, crunches a dive. Good stop at cover. Nice flat throw too from Axar at the non-striker's. Sooryavanshi didn't slide his bat but placed it in just before the ball arrived next to the stumps. No direct hit. Axar was at mid-off, ball was parried to him
Slow again, toes it along the ground to mid-off. Sooryavanshi did check his shot as the low full toss dipped outside off

Ngidi's slower ball doesn't fool Sooryavanshi. He waits for the 116ks offcutter and drives over cover. It was full but he had to hit it slightly on the rise. Was standing on middle and leg, so had some room as the ball was a couple of stumps' width away
Length on middle, flicked back to the bowler

Big chase from cover... too much to do for Tiwari! He ran back, faced the crowd as he reached out and looked to take it on the slide. Tips it onto the cover boundary. Good-looking shot, not perectly timed. Lofted cover drive to a fullish length ball angling away just outside off
Back to yorker attempts. Low full toss on leg, flicked to the right of deep square leg

Maybe that's why Starc was going full. Goes into the pitch and gets pulled over long leg. Pace in the 140ks, back of length at chest-height. Sooryavanshi's stance is open and he swivels while staying above the ball. Seems like the ball is being replaced, may have gotten lost in the crowd

Another yorker attempted, three in a row now. This is a high-ish full toss. Shin-high or a touch above. It angled in and cramped the batter a touch as he looked to swish across the line. Ball hit just below the sticker and went into the pitch
Sooryavanshi's head swings back as the outside edge flies over short third. He wanted to drive the 144ks full ball over mid-off but got a thick edge.
Starc misses his radar. Wanted to spear a yorker into the boot but the 145ks ball was well down leg and a touch too full too
Test stuff. Fuller side of length, lands around fourth and seems to straighten. 136ks. Good leave

Almost out last ball, gone this time! Jaiswal's slump continues. 115ks cutter is full and nearly on the off-side tramline. Jaiswal didn't move across, reached out with his hands and looked to slap it over cover. Thick top edge went high to Starc's right at short third.
Cracker! Beats the straight drive and nearly hits leg stump. Cross-seamer pitched up on leg and beat the inside edge.
Pitched up outside off, driven to cover
Dipping low full toss from around the wicker. Well outside off, Sooryavanshi reaches out and toes a slashy drive past the bowler

First ball and no six for Sooryavanshi? That would be offensive. He got it here but risked a golden duck. The pull sailed just over the leaping deep-backward-square-leg fielder. Ball was back of length at best, Sooryavanshi not upright, raising the bat as he swung from around hip-height
Length on middle and leg, defended to the bowler
Pitched up again, driven again! Sumptuous. Through extra cover. Full length, not a half-volley. Just outside off, no swing, Jaiswal shows off stump and drives along the ground
Goes length now does Starc. Just outside off, defended towards point
Starc pitching it up and Jaiswal handling it nicely. Just a touch of away swing on the full ball just outside off, Jaiswal stays in his crease and punches it dead straight
Jaiswal doesn't miss out on two full tosses in a row. Started on leg stump and swung close to middle, Jaiswal was across and inside the line. Flicks through forward square leg
Misses the yorker, Starc gets away with it. A bit of swing away, finishes just outside off, Jaiswal leans low and drives to mid-off. 139ks
Ashutosh finishes it off with a mighty six and Delhi Capitals stay alive in the playoffs race! He anticipates the short ball after the full one and muscles it away to then hold his arms high
and all Ashutosh has to do watching that field is stand tall, see the ball land near middle and leg and smack it straight down to the long off fence

a run out chance and RR miss another one! Bishnoi at midwicket had only one stump to look at after collection the ball once Ashutosh pulled into the ground, and he had a shy at the stumps at the non-striker's immediately but missed. So Ashutosh gets one and keeps strike too
Ashutosh shows everyone why he's been brought in so late! Hangs back in the crease and opens up, and heaves that away without caring about the length of that one, even if it was short of length
some width, Axar frees his arms towards the covers and wants two, but has two settle for one
wide down the leg side, again Jurel can't collect cleanly and they get two
138.7kmh, pace and full to Axar, he doesn't quite middle the big shot back, single to long on
goes for the wide yorker with pace off completely, Ashutosh digs it out square for one

Miller finds deep midwicket! Put that glass down, there's another plot twist. Brijesh starts with a slower ball on the stumps, Miller wants to muscle it away but all he can do is find Shanaka in the deep for a straightforward catch

Axar connects this time and that's right off the meat of the bat! What a connection. He doesn't have to make room for this one, just stands tall and swings for the hills on the leg side by getting under it nicely. Parag can't believe it and nearly throws his cap
a mighty swing from Miller for the leg side, but no real connection apart from the toe-end for one
Axar also swings big, only one to leg again
slightly full again, he makes room again, but Ferreira chases him and it's only a single down to long on
Miller mows it over long on! He makes room, gets one in the slot and sends that flying over the fielder at the rope
almost yorks him on middle, Axar steers it late towards short third for one
150kmh, quick and full to Miller too, he can't clear cover
full and straight, a quick single down to mid off

Axar goes for the big shot and he gets four! Some respite for DC. Jaiswal almost caught in two minds there, whether to go for the catch or save the boundary. He comes running in first after Axar slashes that over point, but the ball lands well in front and turns away from him
fiery first ball! That hurries towards his abdomen at 148.1kmh, Miller is beaten by pace and just abut manages some bat for one

Archer strikes, Jaiswal runs a mile to take a catch and DC lose one more! Stubbs goes across for the slower ball and scoops it into the stratosphere, Jaiswal comes sprinting in from the rope and swallows that without even having to dive
short and just outside off, soft and delicate dab to deep third for one
an appeal for caught down leg as it's not far from Axar's bat and thigh pad, but called a wide. RR want to review that. No spike there so RR lose a review
he tries to go downtown but can't quite muscle it. Lofts it down to long on for just one
slammed back and that was a really rough chance for Milne, goes off his left hand as he goes low to try and catch it
the keeper can't collect this time. It's a wide way outside off, to be fair to Jurel it also bounces before him and then goes off his leg. Two free runs
full again and flicked this time for one to deep square
yorker on point, 142,2kmh, Stubbs blocks it with respect
charges down for a punch to mid-off where Parag misfields and they leak more runs! Sangakkara  has come screaming out of the dugout
length ball just outside off, clipped to leg for one
beaten by pace as the ball thuds into the thigh pad, but a needless throw concedes two instead of one
short ball and Axar pounces this time, sends the ball sailing over deep square leg for six! That was right off the middle and over the fielder stationed there
pretty slow on off, soft hands to turn the ball to leg and they can't come back for two
chopped on! Knuckle ball on fourth stump line, Rahul goes after it with a back foot punch without any footwork and he gets an inside edge
Rahul works the length ball on the stumps with soft hands to leg and with the field spread out he wants two. Does well to make in back in time
short ball, Axar pulls another and deep midwicket runs across to get to it
excellent yorker, he jams it bat down for one

misfield in the deep from Sooryavanshi and that's four instead of one! Axar pulls this away with a pivot, Sooryavanshi slides to his left from deep fine leg but can't hold on to it and the ball deflects off him to the rope
much better from Punja - straight on middle, Rahul has no room so pushes to long on for one
long hop that deserves to be punished, Rahul can only slam it to cover
some turn on off, Rahul cuts off the back foot but straight to point. He's livid with himself
short and outside off, pulled down to long on for one
148.1kmh, pitched up and Rahul drives it straight to cover. Just two from that over
into the body now and Axar is hopping on his toes, but manages to work it to leg for one
tries to york him first ball with some pace, Axar digs it out

he counters with a swing and only manages an edge! That last delivery probably rattled Parakh a bit. He stands tall this time to swing down the ground, the ball is just short of being in the slot and takes the outside edge for a regulation catch for Jurel
fiery pace which troubles Parakh, who awkwardly half-pulls it to midwicket
some movement outside off, seams it away and Rahul punches off the back foot for one
some turn to end the over too, Rahul again works it off the back foot to leg and gets one
keeps a bit low and well outside the line for a wide on off
some turn from off stump surprises Rahul a bit, he rocks back and turns it to leg in the gap and that's his fifty, off 34 balls
goes flat with the arm outside off, Parakh cuts it square to deep point
just outside off and he cuts to point again. Not a clean collection so Rahul gets one more
really short but with a high release, Parakh has to hop to pull it into the ground on leg
on the back foot and cuts it square for one after the turn
123.7kmh, bangs it into the pitch to end the over and he defends it to cover
yorker steered for four! Such is RR's luck. Right in the block hole around 137kmh, swinging in towards off, and Parakh digs it out with the open face of the bat to get four fine on the off side
pace on to Rahul, who drives it down with a punch to long off
109kmh, nicely disguised slow yorker, and Parakh adjusts nicely to flick it along the ground for one
full and wide, he drives away from the body for two to deep third
Brijesh returns and he strikes first ball! It's a slower delivery at 120kmh and Porel skies that into the night sky, Ferreira settles under it nicely at long on. Porel has done his job though
Fullish length ball just outside off, Rahul goes for the reverse paddle and misses
Good bounce, used nicely to cut it to deep point. Shorter side of length, angles away to go just outside off
Length just outside off, cut to deep point
Leading edge brings up Porel's fifty. He rolls the grip halfway down and raises the bat. Fullish length ball on leg, went for the flick, got it towards cover point
Wide on a length, cut with the spin to deep cover point. 94ks but looked slow

Over the sightscreen, hundred up for DC! Fullish 90ks ball on middle, Rahul takes a step forward and drives through the line. Hit just from in front of the body. Fan who picked up the ball takes a selfie with it and throws it back
Length on off, bat goes around to flick it through forward square leg. Deep midwicket runs in and keeps it to one
Shortish 118ks ball just outside off, cut to deep cover point
Good stop from Archer, running to the right. Palmed the ball in with one hand. Pitched up just outside off, driven along the ground through cover
Lack of timing helps Rahul as ball lands well in front of wide long-on. Fullish ball outside off, batter swung across the line and looked to go aerial
Wide on a length, Rahul slices it with an open-face to backward point. No one behind the fielder there
Pitched up on off, driven to long-off
Goes back and pulls the 95ks length ball from middle stump to deep midwicket.
Pitched up on off, 91ks and floaty, Rahul muscles a drive. Non-striker's down and it rolls to long-on
Length on off, flicked to deep-forward square
Goes back and pulls it from outside off to long-on. 92ks
Back of length just outside off, cut to cover
Fullish length just outside off, square driven off the back foot to backward point
Shortish ball outside off, cut to cover. 106ks. Ball not sticking for Shanaka
Length outside off, driven to deep point
Slot ball, Rahul cannons it into the boundary board. Right on the blackened bit of the board towards long-on. Full ball around fifth stump, Rahul waited with a slight lunge and drove through the line
Back of length just outside off, cut to deep point

124ks bouncer has been upper-cut with a late flick of the wrists. Tennis-ball bounce on the ball as it angled away towards fourth stump, Porel got slightly off the ground, went fine and over the infield
Slower ball first up, might be a good ploy. Full and floaty just outside off, Rahul looks to drive straight and hard. Inside edges to deep square leg

Sweet sound. Back foot drive through cover. Slower one around a back of length just outside off, did not rise, but gave Porel ample time while staying back in the crease to power it. RR take the timeout straightaway
Slower bouncer, Porel puts pace on it with a twirling pull. Very short, landed on off and finished around leg at belly-height. Porel winding up big and swiping across his chest
Shows all stumps, gets followed by a length ball. Flicks to deep-backward point's left
Back of length on leg, gets square on and flicks to deep-backward square
Fullish on leg, punched from outside the crease to long-on
Length outside off, cut to deep-backward point
Good timing, placement not as much. Ferreira got low to his left and stopped the racing ball. Halfway length outside off, cut hard
Length just outside off, run down to deep third
Fullish on leg, punches it against the angle to mid-off
This one comes at an easy pace and Rahul pulls over midwicket. Hit from in front of the body. Halfway length at the stumps
On the bounce to the keeper, deflects off the torso to the left as he was sitting on his knees. Was slightly outside off, beat the bat. Seemed skiddy
Shortish ball around off, Rahul jumps and defends it towards point. Took the pace right off for an easy single
Full on leg, 120ks, flicked to deep square leg
Thick edge along the ground to deep third. Porel got low for the cover drive. Was a length ball at pace just outside off
Wide called by the square-leg ump. Porel went for a full-fledged cut, the bat turned 360 degrees but didn't meet the slower short ball around the off-side tramline
Slower one into a back of length from around the wicket, 116ks, pulled off the toe to midwicket
Dances down, gets no room, still steers it in the gap. He was a little too late on the slightly open-faced drive to the length ball, ball went off the toe through point

Gentlest of upper cuts goes fine of short third. Porel wound up big, bat behind and well above his shoulder, then he pulled off the power, jumped and dinked the ball with a poke. Checked the shot too, fully in control
135ks full ball on middle and leg, driven to long-on. Brijesh's towel, tucked on his trouser, flew to the right while releasing the ball

Is that in the ground? Bounces over the roof... and seems to have gone outside! Porel anything but rushed this time. Covered leg stump, used the pace on the back-of-length ball on his front thigh and lifts a flick. Just 92 metres, looked like it'd have been more
Length just outside off, inside-halfs an open-faced punch to the bowler
147ks shortish ball hits Porel on the left flank. That'll sting, he walks across and rubs his hip. Leg-stump line again, Porel went for the pull, got beaten on the under-edge
Length on leg, flicked to long leg.
Archer screeches as Rahul's caught halfway down, Perreira runs left from midwicket... and can't pick up the ball cleanly as Rahul dives back. Ball flicked off the top of the stumps
Bad ball. Back of length on the hip, Rahul stays back and uses the angle in. Hops a touch and flicks to the left of deep-backward square who dives in vain
Fullish length ball outside off, Rahul goes hard for a slappy cover drive. Gets it off the bottom
Pitched up around off, driven to mid-off's right

Rahul misses out, finds cover point with the cut... And gets four overthrows despite the direct hit Ball bounced off the top of the bail and went through midwicket, Rahul well in. There was room on that length ball, Rahul timed the cut into the ground
Pitched up outside off, driven to cover

Half-volley whipped over midwicket. Flat hit over the infield. It did swing in late, finished on the pads. Porel keeping his head low and across as he hit it, held his shape with bat in hand while taking a couple of steps forward
